findings.rationale: The materialized filename is derived only from the source stem and process ID, so repeated or concurrent materializations of the same document within one process share a path. std::fs::write non-exclusively overwrites that predictable path, and either guard's Drop can remove it while another user still needs it. A pre-created symlink can also redirect the write to another file.

The induction base case executes BMC using the original selection before auxiliary lemmas are added by load_induction_model. The later induction proof may therefore rely on an auxiliary invariant that was never established for initial or bounded reachable states, allowing a false but inductive lemma to strengthen the proof and produce an unsound verification result.
